```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(lmerTest)
library(plotrix)
library(gtools)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(mediation)
library(afex)
library(effsize)
library(bwrappers)
library(apa)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjstats)
library(simr)
afex_options(emmeans_model = "multivariate")
```


```{r}
# Import data
col_names <- names(read_csv(here("data", "disagreement_exp2_raw_data.csv")))
d1 <- read_csv(here("data", "disagreement_exp2_raw_data.csv"), 
                     col_names = col_names, skip = 3) %>%
  # remove blank columns that are included
  dplyr::select(-...116:-...136)

# one dataset with BOTH exclusions and pairs run in non-random condition (d5), and other with JUST exclusions (d4)
## Remove preview responses
d2 = d1[d1$Status==0,]
d3 <- d2 %>%
  filter(is.na(Preview_1)) 
#= d2[!(d2$Preview_1==1),]

# Remove JUST exclusions (wrong conditions are excluded below)
# MAIN ANALYSES ARE DONE ON JUST EXCLUSIONS, because results are unchanged when include non-random pairs
#d3[is.na(d3)] <- 0
d4 <- d3 %>%
  filter(is.na(Exclude)) 

d4 <- d4 %>%
  # Add individual participant ID numbers
  mutate(ParticID = seq.int(nrow(d4)),
         # create averages of attitude perception measures across topics for each participant
         avg_certainty = (AbortCert + SameSexCert + GunCert + BLMCert + FamilyCert + ClimateCert + 
                            GodCert + RestrictCert + ChurchCert) / 9,
         avg_moral = (AbortMor + SameSexMor + GunMor + BLMMor + FamilyMor + ClimateMor + 
                            GodMor + RestrictMor + ChurchMor) / 9,
         avg_care = (AbortCare + SameSexCare + GunCare + BLMCare + FamilyCare + ClimateCare + 
                            GodCare + RestrictCare + ChurchCare) / 9,
         # Initalize these to create dummy variables later
         is_agree = 0,
         is_uncertain = 0,
         is_experience = 0)
# = d3[!(d3$Exclude==1),]

# Manually fix one pair that was (probably accidentally) run in the wrong condition, in the sense that the assigned topic was one participants agreed on but they were supposed to disagree (but the survey should've told them each other's attitudes, so they should've known that they actually agreed...)
# Also mark them as being run in the "wrong condition"
d4[d4$ResponseId == "R_PZINqQtfEM6Zghb", "Condition"] <- 4
d4[d4$ResponseId == "R_PZINqQtfEM6Zghb", "WrongCond"] <- 1

d4[d4$ResponseId == "R_2cAvpF1H0oJxgG7", "Condition"] <- 4
d4[d4$ResponseId == "R_2cAvpF1H0oJxgG7", "WrongCond"] <- 1


# Long form dataset
predict_data <- d4 %>%
  dplyr::select(-EnjoyExper:-SimExper) %>%
  rename(Enjoy = EnjoyExpec,
         Awk = AwkExpec,
         Learn = LearnExpec,
         Hostile = HostileExpec,
         Like = LikeExpec,
         PLike = PLikeExpec,
         Con = ConExpec,
         Sim = SimExpec) %>%
  mutate(Phase = "prediction")

experience_data <- d4 %>%
  dplyr::select(-EnjoyExpec:-SimExpec) %>%
  rename(Enjoy = EnjoyExper,
         Awk = AwkExper,
         Learn = LearnExper,
         Hostile = HostileExper,
         Like = LikeExper,
         PLike = PLikeExper,
         Con = ConExper,
         Sim = SimExper) %>%
  mutate(Phase = "experience")
  
  disagree_data <- bind_rows(predict_data, experience_data) %>%
    mutate(Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c("prediction", "experience")),
           interaction_composite = (Enjoy + (10 - Awk) + Learn + (10 - Hostile)) / 4) %>%
    rename(PairID = ID)
  
# 1 is agreement condition, 2 is disagreement condition
disagree_data$Condition = as.factor(as.character(disagree_data$Condition))
disagree_data$ConditionCombined = disagree_data$Condition
levels(disagree_data$ConditionCombined) <- c(levels(disagree_data$ConditionCombined),"3")
# 4 is uncertain/agree, 5 is uncertain/disagree
# Recoding both as 3 for overall uncertainty condition
disagree_data$ConditionCombined[disagree_data$ConditionCombined==4] <- "3"
disagree_data$ConditionCombined[disagree_data$ConditionCombined==5] <- "3"

# Subset again by expectation and experience
expectation_only <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(Phase == "prediction")

experience_only <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(Phase == "experience")

# Bind them together again to use for calculating differences between expectations and experiences (i.e., proportions of P's who overestimated vs. underestimated vs. were calibrated)
disagree_data_short <- bind_cols(expectation_only, experience_only) %>%
  dplyr::rename(interaction_composite_expect = "interaction_composite...116",
                interaction_composite_exper = "interaction_composite...233") %>%
  mutate(interaction_composite_diff = case_when(
    interaction_composite_expect > interaction_composite_exper ~ "overestimate",
    interaction_composite_expect < interaction_composite_exper ~ "underestimate",
    interaction_composite_expect == interaction_composite_exper ~ "calibrated",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# Create dataset that excludes non-randomly assigned pairs
disagree_nonrandom <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(is.na(WrongCond))


# For additional analyses: create condition variable for informed vs. uninformed, and for agree vs. disagree (when combining across uncertainty conditions)
disagree_data <- disagree_data %>%
  mutate(agree_conditions_combined = fct_recode(Condition,
                                                "agree" = "1",
                                                "disagree" = "2",
                                                "agree" = "4",
                                                "disagree" = "5"),
         informed_conditions_combined = fct_recode(Condition,
                                                   "informed" = "1",
                                                   "informed" = "2",
                                                   "uninformed" = "4",
                                                   "uninformed" = "5"))


# Subset of data with no Uncertainty condition (for manipulation check)
disagree_data_no_uncert <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(ConditionCombined != 3) %>%
  mutate(ConditionCombined = factor(ConditionCombined, levels = c("1", "2")))


#disagree_data %>%
 # dplyr::select(Condition, agree_conditions_combined, informed_conditions_combined)

# Checking exclusion info below
#d3 %>% filter(!is.na(Exclude)) %>% filter(ResponseId != "R_3kdY6qelLdlTEJq")  
  # %>% dplyr::select(Condition) %>% group_by(Condition) %>% dplyr::summarize(count = n())
```


# MAIN ANALYSES REPORTED IN PAPER

# Manipulation check

```{r}
wrap.t.ind(disagree_data_no_uncert$Sim[disagree_data_no_uncert$Phase == "prediction"],
           disagree_data_no_uncert$ConditionCombined[disagree_data_no_uncert$Phase == "prediction"],
           var.equal = FALSE)
```

```{r}
disagree_data %>%
  group_by(ConditionCombined, Phase) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = round(mean(Sim),2),
                   sd = round(sd(Sim),2),
                   se = round(std.error(Sim),2))
```

Full ANOVA on Just Expectations:

```{r}
manip_check_model = lmer(Sim ~ ConditionCombined + (1|PairID),
                      data = expectation_only)
anova(manip_check_model)
eta_squared(manip_check_model)
```

```{r}
pairs(emmeans(manip_check_model, "ConditionCombined")) %>%
  kable()
```

# Alphas

```{r}
psych::alpha(data.frame(predict_data$Enjoy, (10 - predict_data$Awk), predict_data$Learn, 
                        (10 - predict_data$Hostile)))
psych::alpha(data.frame(experience_data$Enjoy, (10 - experience_data$Awk), experience_data$Learn, 
                        (10 - experience_data$Hostile)))
```

# Composite model

```{r}
modelComposite = lmer(interaction_composite ~ Phase*ConditionCombined + (1|PairID) + (1|PairID:ParticID),
                      data = disagree_data)
anova(modelComposite)
eta_squared(anova(modelComposite))
```
            
```{r}
pairs(emmeans(modelComposite, "Phase", by = "ConditionCombined")) %>%
  kable()
```


```{r}
emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(modelComposite, "Phase", by = "ConditionCombined"), 
         sigma = stats::sigma(modelComposite),
                       edf = stats::df.residual(modelComposite)) %>%
  #dplyr::select(-SE, -lower.CL, -upper.CL) %>%
  kable(caption = "Effect Sizes")
```

```{r}
pairs(emmeans(modelComposite, "ConditionCombined", by = "Phase")) %>%
  kable()
```

# Figure of Composite Results

```{r}
disagree_data %>%
  group_by(ConditionCombined, Phase) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(interaction_composite),
                   count = n(),
            upper = mean(interaction_composite) + std.error(interaction_composite),
            lower = mean(interaction_composite) - std.error(interaction_composite)) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = ConditionCombined, y = mean, fill = Phase)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = c(0,2,4,6,8,10)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Agree", "Disagree", "Uncertain")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "gray30"), labels = c("Expected", "Experienced")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Mean Composite of Positive Experiences", x = "Agreement Condition", 
       fill = "Phase") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 13))
```

Violin plot:

```{r}
means_data <- disagree_data %>%
  group_by(ConditionCombined, Phase) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_val = mean(interaction_composite),
    upper = mean(interaction_composite) + sd(interaction_composite),
    lower = mean(interaction_composite) - sd(interaction_composite)
  )

ggplot(data = disagree_data, mapping = aes(x = ConditionCombined, y = interaction_composite, fill = Phase)) +
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  
  # Calculate the mean and standard error for each condition
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.5) +
  
  # Display jittered data points
  geom_jitter(size = 2, alpha = 0.4, 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.9)) +
  # Add mean points with distinctive shape and color
  geom_point(data = means_data, aes(y = mean_val, fill = Phase, group = Phase),
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", size = 3.5, shape = 23) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1" = "Agree", 
                              "2" = "Disagree", 
                              "3" = "Uncertain")) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("prediction" = "Expectation",
                      "experience" = "Experience")) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Composite Rating") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
```

# Intraclass-correlation coefficient (ICC)


```{r}
# Manually computing ICCs for PairID specifically
# Composite
var_pair <- VarCorr(modelComposite)$PairID[1]
var_partic_within_pair <- VarCorr(modelComposite)$`PairID:ParticID`[1]
var_residual <- attr(VarCorr(modelComposite), "sc")^2

icc_pair <- var_pair / (var_pair + var_partic_within_pair + var_residual)
icc_pair

# Checking for full model
(var_pair + var_partic_within_pair) / (var_pair + var_partic_within_pair + var_residual)
```

```{r}
# Liking
var_pair <- VarCorr(modelLike)$PairID[1]
var_partic_within_pair <- VarCorr(modelLike)$`PairID:ParticID`[1]
var_residual <- attr(VarCorr(modelLike), "sc")^2

icc_pair <- var_pair / (var_pair + var_partic_within_pair + var_residual)
icc_pair
```


```{r}
# Connectedness
var_pair <- VarCorr(modelCon)$PairID[1]
var_partic_within_pair <- VarCorr(modelCon)$`PairID:ParticID`[1]
var_residual <- attr(VarCorr(modelCon), "sc")^2

icc_pair <- var_pair / (var_pair + var_partic_within_pair + var_residual)
icc_pair

# Checking for full model
(var_pair + var_partic_within_pair) / (var_pair + var_partic_within_pair + var_residual)
```

```{r}
# Simple correlations because some measures have singularity issues
# Need to get the pairings
first_in_pair_pred <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(Phase == "prediction") %>%
  group_by(PairID) %>%
  slice(1)

first_in_pair_exper <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(Phase == "experience") %>%
  group_by(PairID) %>%
  slice(1)

second_in_pair_pred <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(Phase == "prediction") %>%
  group_by(PairID) %>%
  slice(2)

second_in_pair_exper <- disagree_data %>%
  filter(Phase == "experience") %>%
  group_by(PairID) %>%
  slice(2)

# Match up predictions (to make sure they're paired properly, just in case ordering gets off)
paired_pred <- left_join(first_in_pair_pred, second_in_pair_pred, by = "PairID")

# Match up experiences (to make sure they're paired properly, just in case ordering gets off)
paired_exper <- left_join(first_in_pair_exper, second_in_pair_exper, by = "PairID")

# Compute the correlations on the measures, separately for predictions and experiences, WITHIN each condition

# COMPOSITE, AGREE
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$interaction_composite.x[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "1"],
                 paired_pred$interaction_composite.y[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "1"]))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$interaction_composite.x[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "1"],
                 paired_exper$interaction_composite.y[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "1"]))

# COMPOSITE, DISAGREE
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$interaction_composite.x[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "2"],
                 paired_pred$interaction_composite.y[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "2"]))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$interaction_composite.x[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "2"],
                 paired_exper$interaction_composite.y[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "2"]))

# COMPOSITE, UNCERTAIN
# expectations
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$interaction_composite.x[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "3"],
                 paired_pred$interaction_composite.y[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "3"]))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$interaction_composite.x[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "3"],
                 paired_exper$interaction_composite.y[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "3"]))

####

# LIKING, AGREE (focusing on this since it's the one that had singularity issues with the ICC)

cor_apa(cor.test(paired_pred$Like.x[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "1"],
                 paired_pred$Like.y[paired_pred$ConditionCombined.x == "1"]))
# experiences
cor_apa(cor.test(paired_exper$Like.x[paired_exper$ConditionCombined.x == "1"],

# LIKING, DISAGREE

# experiences

# LIKING, UNCERTAIN
```

# Power Analysis

```{r}
# MAIN POWER ANALYSIS TO DO THE 3x2

#### Power Analyses Using doSim and doFit ####
library(lme4); library(simr)

# Fit a mixed linear model to the original data set
original_model <- lmer(interaction_composite ~ Phase*ConditionCombined + (1|PairID) + (1|PairID:ParticID),
                      data = disagree_data)
 
# Run ANOVA to confirm that the interaction term produces the same F statistics or p values that we report in the paper
anova(original_model)

# Perform a power calculation
nsim <- 1000
p_values <- NULL
for(i in 1:nsim) {
  new_data_set <- doSim(original_model) # Simulate a new version of the data set based on the original model
  new_model <- doFit(new_data_set,original_model) # Fit a new model to the simulated data set
  new_anova <- anova(new_model); new_anova # Perform ANOVA over the new model
 # print(new_anova); print(new_anova[3,4])
  new_p_value <- pf(new_anova[3,4],2,195,lower.tail=F) # Extract the p value of the interaction term (entry [3,4] in the ANOVA table) in the new model, using F(2, 195)
  p_values <- c(p_values,new_p_value) # Store the p value of the interaction term
}

sum(p_values<=.05)/length(p_values) # Compute the statistical power
```


```{r}
# Power analysis on the 2x2x2 version of the design

#### Power Analyses Using doSim and doFit ####
library(lme4); library(simr)

# Fit a mixed linear model to the original data set
original_model <- lmer(interaction_composite ~ Phase * agree_conditions_combined * informed_conditions_combined 
                       + (1|PairID) + (1|PairID:ParticID),
                      data = disagree_data)
 
# Run ANOVA to confirm that the interaction term produces the same F statistics or p values that we report in the paper
anova(original_model)

# Perform a power calculation
nsim <- 1000
p_values <- NULL
for(i in 1:nsim) {
  new_data_set <- doSim(original_model) # Simulate a new version of the data set based on the original model
  new_model <- doFit(new_data_set,original_model) # Fit a new model to the simulated data set
  new_anova <- anova(new_model); new_anova # Perform ANOVA over the new model
  #print(new_anova); print(new_anova[7,4])
  new_p_value <- pf(new_anova[7,4],1,196,lower.tail=F) # Extract the p value of the interaction term (entry [7,4] in the ANOVA table) in the new model, using F(1, 196)
  p_values <- c(p_values,new_p_value) # Store the p value of the interaction term
}

sum(p_values<=.05)/length(p_values) # Compute the statistical power
```
